env.//: Allows the investigator roles (researcher, test-writer) to spawn their own helper subagents for parallel legwork. Project-scoped on purpose (not ~/.claude) so the blast radius stays in this repo. Depth 2 = Arbiter -> investigator -> helper. Only agents with `Agent` in their tools: line can actually spawn; devil/verifier/angel deliberately omit it. See CLAUDE.md 'Nested spawning'.
